opinions.text:
Temp. Emerg. Ct. App. Motion of Texas City Refining, Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice Brennan would grant certiorari. The order heretofore entered by Justice Brennan on September 3, 1981, is vacated.
